blockingFindings.summary: submitStage reports and persists succeeded before invoking any GLB, USDZ, or PBR validator; corrupt output tests validate only after success.
Durable evidence is written only on success; uncertainty, HTTP error, poll timeout, failure, and cancellation return without evidence.
A 307/308 redirect can issue a second physical paid POST inside fetchWithApprovedRedirects.
Direct production library calls can omit apiKey and still reach the network.
Successful outcomes retain raw Buffers which the operator CLI JSON-serializes to stdout.
Polling JSON lacks content-type and body-size bounds; malformed responses throw before durable evidence.
SSRF checks are lexical only with no DNS pinning/rebinding defense; evidence and replay containment do not reject symlinks.
Evidence bundle writes are sequential and can leave an unmarked partial bundle.
429/5xx creation responses are assigned consumedCredits zero without authoritative provider documentation or task evidence.
R3 RUN_SUMMARY overstates completion with everythingElseImplementedAndTested true and no blockers.

reviewLimitations: The reviewer did not linearly inspect every one of the 82 changed files and therefore did not cover the additional manager findings recorded in MESHY-002-R5.
No live Meshy or adversarial external DNS call was made, as required by the zero-credit read-only boundary.
The Apple/iOS simulator probe was not rerun by this reviewer.
